notes: No fiction found in this batch. Removed entries are parent/sub-theme duplicates (the parent keeps only members not in its sub-themes). The 11 places themes (vet clinic ... ski resort) are SEPARATE: their words are things found at the place, not workplaces/places to visit. Not separate but borderline: towers and skyscrapers (mixes tower types with famous named towers such as Big Ben, Eiffel Tower) and shops (some entries read as trades: butcher, florist, tailor). Added UK shop forms butcher's, chemist's, newsagent's alongside the plain forms. Kept plain forms where English dictionaries do: pho, ao dai, smorgasbord, bandoneon, kowhai, autobahn.
